description: US-001: Add `services` support to `ral.json` config loading (docker-compose service definitions)
steps: Update config types/schema to allow a top-level `services` object keyed by service name
Support `type: "docker-compose"` service definitions with fields: `cwd`, `composeFile`, `service`, `healthcheckUrl`
Validate service config with clear errors for missing/invalid fields (e.g., missing `composeFile`, invalid `healthcheckUrl` URL string)
Add/extend unit tests for config loading/validation covering: valid service config, missing required fields, invalid URL
Run pnpm test:run to verify tests pass
Typecheck passes

description: US-002: Implement `ral service start <name>` (non-blocking Docker Compose up -d)
steps: Add a new CLI command: `ral service start <name>` (Commander wiring + command implementation)
Resolve `<name>` from `ral.json` `services` and ensure `type` is `docker-compose` (error if not found/unsupported)
Run Docker Compose equivalent of: `docker compose -f <composeFile> up -d <service>` from configured `cwd`
Make the command idempotent when already running (safe to re-run without failing)
Add unit tests for: missing service name, unknown service, and a happy-path start invocation (mocking shell execution)
Run pnpm test:run to verify tests pass
Typecheck passes

description: US-003: Implement `ral service stop <name>` (Docker Compose stop; idempotent)
steps: Add a new CLI command: `ral service stop <name>`
Run Docker Compose equivalent of: `docker compose -f <composeFile> stop <service>` from configured `cwd`
Make the command idempotent when already stopped (safe to re-run without failing)
Add unit tests for: unknown service and a happy-path stop invocation (mocking shell execution)
Run pnpm test:run to verify tests pass
Typecheck passes

description: US-004: Implement `ral service status <name>` with HTTP healthcheck and `--json` output
steps: Add a new CLI command: `ral service status <name> [--json]`
Determine `running` using Docker Compose (e.g., `docker compose -f <composeFile> ps --status running --format json <service>` from configured `cwd`; do not assume the JSON is always a single array)
Determine `healthy` by issuing an HTTP request to `healthcheckUrl` with a short timeout; set `healthy=false` on non-2xx or timeout
When `--json` is provided, output stable JSON including at least: `name`, `type`, `running`, `healthy`, `healthcheckUrl`, `composeFile`, `composeService`
Add unit tests covering: running/not-running parsing and healthcheck success/failure (mock HTTP + shell execution)
Run pnpm test:run to verify tests pass
Typecheck passes

description: US-005: Implement `ral service logs <name>` with `--tail` (tail-and-exit default) and optional `--json`
steps: Add a new CLI command: `ral service logs <name> [--tail <n>] [--json]`
Default behavior: fetch the last 200 lines and exit (no follow/attach)
Run Docker Compose equivalent of: `docker compose -f <composeFile> logs --tail <n> <service>` from configured `cwd`
If `--json` is implemented, output a JSON object containing metadata and a `lines` array (or document that logs are plain text in v1 if JSON is not feasible)
Add unit tests for: default tail value, custom tail, unknown service (mock shell execution)
Run pnpm test:run to verify tests pass
Typecheck passes

description: US-001a: Document `services` config + `ral service …` commands in README
steps: Update `README.md` to document `services` in `ral.json`, including a Vite + React example (`type`, `cwd`, `composeFile`, `service`, `healthcheckUrl`)
Update `README.md` to document `ral service start|stop|status|logs` with example invocations (including `status --json` and `logs --tail 200`)
Ensure README guidance tells agents not to run dev servers directly, and to use `ral service …` instead
Typecheck passes

description: US-006: Add “don’t run dev servers directly” guidance to scaffolded `prompt.md` template(s)
steps: Update the appropriate `prompt.md` template(s) to include concise guidance: do not start dev servers directly (`pnpm dev`, `vite`); use `ral service start|stop|status|logs`
Place the guidance near other operational constraints so agents see it early
Add/adjust template unit tests if needed to account for the new prompt text
Run pnpm test:run to verify tests pass
Typecheck passes
